title: Harbor of Hope Event Summary
content: The 'Harbor of Hope' event held on February 15th was a resounding success, with over 200 community members in attendance. The atmosphere was one of solidarity and support for our immigrant neighbors, including the undocumented. Keynote speeches were delivered by Councilman Thomas Green and local activist Sarah Lin, who both emphasized the importance of community support for all residents, regardless of their immigration status. Notably, the event was also attended by Maria Rodriguez, an undocumented immigrant whose passionate advocacy and volunteer work within the community was highlighted during the event.

title: Harbor of Hope Event Planning
content: Planning details for the 'Harbor of Hope' event included securing a venue, arranging for speakers, and coordinating with local immigrant rights groups to ensure a meaningful and impactful gathering, with special attention to the participation of undocumented immigrants like Maria Rodriguez.
